aquilineProfiles.hint: Aquiline profiles cannot be deleted — the provider API only supports reading and updating one, not removing it. A profile created by mistake, a race, or a test permanently consumes one of the plan's slots. Shipments above reset every billing window; this count never does.

settings.intro: Runtime configuration. Each setting resolves as database override, then environment variable, then code default — reset a setting to fall back to the environment. Secrets and connection credentials stay in the environment and are not editable here.

descriptions.keepa.refresh.enabled: Master switch for the background Keepa refresh scheduler. Turning it off stops all background token spend immediately, with no restart needed.
descriptions.keepa.refresh.intervalMinutes: How often the scheduler claims a batch of products to refresh from Keepa. Lower values refresh more often but spend Keepa tokens faster.
descriptions.keepa.refresh.batchSize: How many products are claimed per refresh tick. Batches over 100 are chunked automatically, so this can safely exceed Keepa's per-call limit.
descriptions.keepa.refresh.claimLeaseMinutes: How long a claimed batch is reserved before it becomes due again. Must exceed the worst-case batch runtime including retries, or a product could be claimed twice.
descriptions.keepa.refresh.maxFailures: Number of consecutive data failures (ASIN missing from a Keepa response) before a product is quarantined and stops being refreshed.
descriptions.keepa.refresh.quarantineMinutes: How long a product stays quarantined after hitting the failure threshold before refresh is retried.
descriptions.keepa.refresh.schedulerCron: Cron pattern for the refresh scheduler tick. The repeatable job is registered once at boot, so a change here needs an API restart to take effect.
descriptions.amazon.orderSync.cron: How often each Amazon buyer account is scraped to auto-capture order costs. Cost scales with account count, not sales volume — raising the frequency only speeds up how soon already-placed orders get their real costs written; nothing a seller waits on runs here.
descriptions.amazon.orderSync.matchTolerancePct: Maximum percentage difference allowed between the Amazon order total and the eBay sale total for an automatic cost match.
descriptions.amazon.orderSync.matchWindowDays: Maximum number of days allowed between the Amazon and eBay order dates for an automatic cost match.
descriptions.amazon.tracking.preshipIntervalHours: How often an order is polled for a ship-out event before it has shipped. Baked into per-order schedulers at boot — a restart is needed to apply a new value to already-scheduled orders.
descriptions.amazon.tracking.shippedIntervalHours: How often a shipped order is polled for delivery status. Also requires a restart to apply to already-scheduled orders.
descriptions.autoFulfill.reviewCapHardStop: When on, the automated Amazon purchase aborts before clicking 'Place Order' if the review-page total exceeds the buyer account's spend cap.
descriptions.autoFulfill.evidenceTtlDays: How many days full-page evidence screenshots from automated purchases are kept before being deleted.
descriptions.email.smtpHost: Hostname of the SMTP server used to send platform emails.
descriptions.email.smtpPort: Port used to connect to the SMTP server (587 for STARTTLS, 465 for implicit TLS).
descriptions.email.smtpSecure: Use implicit TLS when connecting to the SMTP server.
descriptions.email.smtpUser: Username used to authenticate with the SMTP server.
descriptions.email.smtpPassword: Password used to authenticate with the SMTP server. Stored encrypted and never shown again once set.
descriptions.email.smtpFrom: The From address platform emails are sent from.
descriptions.admin.queueWaitingThreshold: Number of waiting jobs in a queue that triggers a warning on the Overview tab.
descriptions.admin.keepaLowTokensThreshold: Keepa token balance below which a low-balance warning is shown.
descriptions.admin.llmFailureRateThreshold: AI request failure rate (%) above which a warning is shown.
descriptions.admin.listingQuotaWarnThreshold: Number of active listings for a user that triggers a warning-level quota badge.
descriptions.admin.listingQuotaCriticalThreshold: Number of active listings for a user that triggers a critical-level quota badge.
descriptions.admin.amazonAccountQuotaWarnThreshold: Number of Amazon buyer accounts for a user that triggers a warning-level quota badge.
descriptions.admin.amazonAccountQuotaCriticalThreshol: Number of Amazon buyer accounts for a user that triggers a critical-level quota badge.
descriptions.llm.contentEnabled: Master switch for AI-generated listing titles and descriptions at create time. Off by default; a failure always falls back to the deterministic title.
descriptions.billing.enforcementEnabled: When on, listing and automatic-order quotas are actually enforced against a user's plan. Off gives every user full access without a real subscription.
descriptions.buyerMessaging.feedbackDefaultDelayDays: Default number of days after delivery before the feedback-request message is sent, when a store hasn't set its own delay.
descriptions.amazon.browserProfileGc.enabled: Master switch for the nightly cleanup of Amazon browser profiles — cache pruning and disk reclaim for unused or orphaned accounts.
descriptions.amazon.browserProfileGc.dormantDays: Days a browser profile can sit unused before it is fully removed, forcing a re-login on next use. Set to 0 to disable full removal while keeping cache pruning.
descriptions.amazon.browserProfileGc.purgeOrphans: Remove browser profiles belonging to Amazon accounts that no longer exist in the database.
descriptions.retention.queueObservationsDays: How many days of BullMQ queue completed/failed event history are kept.
descriptions.retention.keepaUsageLogDays: How many days of per-ASIN Keepa token usage log rows are kept.
descriptions.retention.llmUsageLogDays: How many days of AI usage log rows (tokens, cost) are kept.
descriptions.retention.usageEventsDays: How many days of the FinOps cost-projection table that feeds the Costs tab are kept.
descriptions.retention.buyerMessageLogDays: How many days buyer message log rows are kept. This table also prevents duplicate messages for the same order/event — deleting a row re-arms that event, so the floor is deliberately long.
descriptions.retention.auditLogsDays: How many days audit log rows (role changes, setting changes) are kept. Kept long for compliance evidence.
descriptions.retention.listingRevisionsDays: How many days of listing revision history are kept for the detail page's Revisions drawer.
descriptions.ebay.aspects.llmEnabled: Allow the AI to choose a required eBay item specific when no cheaper deterministic layer could supply one. Off by default.
descriptions.ebay.aspects.llmMaxPerListing: Maximum number of item specifics the AI is allowed to resolve per listing when the AI aspect layer is enabled.

listingQuality.autofilledHint: A required specific had no product value, so a broad-but-true one was used.
listingQuality.defaultsHint: Curated values beat the automatic ones and apply to every customer listing in that category.

ebayLimits.description: eBay meters API calls per application, not per seller - every customer draws from this one daily pool. Background jobs stop at the reduced ceiling so seller-triggered actions always have budget left.
ebayLimits.emptyDescription: Counters appear once the platform makes its first eBay call today.

listingFailures.description: Operator diagnostics. Sellers only ever see the localized reason; the raw provider message is shown here because it names eBay error ids and internal fields.
listingFailures.emptyDescription: Failed create attempts appear here with the raw provider error.
